en: The Five-Limb Recitation Method of the Concise and Swift Gate of Mahāvairocana:
Recite the Three Vajra Mantras three times.
*Namaḥ samantabuddhānām, ācāme trāme samaye svāhā*. Recite the Dharmadhātujāta-mantra three times:
*Namaḥ samantabuddhānām, dharmadhātu svabhāvapada hūṃ*. Recite the Mahādharmacakrapravartana-mantra three times:
*Namo samanta-vajrāya vajra-tam-ku-haṃ.* Recite this Vajra-body-protection mantra three times.
*Namo samanta-vajrāya vajra-kavace hūṃ.* Recite this Vairocana root mantra seven times.
*Namo samanta-buddhānām svāhā.* Recite this Acala mantra seven times.
*Namo samanta-vajra-śaktana mahā-rūṣaṇa-sphoṭaya hūṃ trāṭa haṃ khaṃ.* Recite this *Samantapūjā-mantra* three times.
*Namo samanta-buddhānāṃ svāhā khaṃ yuṃ na gati sphara haṃ ga-gana-jaṃ svāhā.* Recite this *Dhūpa-mantra* (Incense Mantra) three times.
*Namo samanta-buddhānāṃ dharma-dhātu-jāti svāhā.* Recite this *Arghya-mantra* (Water Offering Mantra) three times.
*Namo samantabuddhānāṃ gaganasamāsambhava svāhā.* Recite the mantra of Ucchuṣma-vajra five times: *Oṃ kuru dhuna hūṃ jaḥ*. *Jia Ci Jue* (Jia Ci Jue) records:
*The One-Scroll Method for the Five-Limb Recitation of the Brief Essential Gate of Mahāvairocana*, translated by Ren Yun Rui.
